name: AI Agent Implant & Command Channel
description: An AI agent installed, re-pointed or taken over inside the target's environment and then tasked by the attacker from outside — through a chat bot (Telegram, Matrix), the API or web interface of an AI service, an MCP connection to an attacker server, or the agent's own scheduler — so that it runs commands, collects data and exfiltrates on the attacker's behalf. The agent's legitimate tools become the implant's capabilities, and its traffic blends with normal AI use.
differs: Defined by the remote command channel: the agent works for the attacker from inside the target's environment. Persistent edits to what governs the agent are Agent Configuration & Prompt Logic Tampering (T9.001), often the way the implant is set up; the attacker's own agents attacking from their infrastructure are Adversary-Operated AI Agent (T8.005); a single steering of the target's agent through content it reads is Agentic Tool Misuse (T3.001).
